Definition: to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be clean, be pure; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be clean (physically-of disease); 1a2) to be clean ceremonially; 1a3) to purify, be clean morally, made clean; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to cleanse, purify; 1b1a) physically; 1b1b) ceremonially; 1b1c) morally; 1b2) to pronounce clean; 1b3) to perform the ceremony of cleansing; 1c) (Pual) to be cleansed, be pronounced clean; 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to purify oneself; 1d1a) ceremonially; 1d1b) morally; 1d2) to present oneself for purification
